name: LED Blinker
description: Build a low-voltage circuit that makes an LED blink using a simple timing circuit.
safety: Use a battery-powered low-voltage supply and check LED polarity.

name: Mini Traffic Light
description: Use three LEDs to model a traffic light and practice sequencing outputs.
safety: Use only USB or battery power at low voltage.

name: Light-Level Indicator
description: Make an indicator respond to changes in room brightness using a light-sensitive component.
safety: Keep the circuit low voltage and avoid short circuits.

name: Pushbutton Counter
description: Count button presses and show the value with LEDs or a small display.

name: Temperature Display
description: Read a temperature sensor and show the measurement on a small display.
safety: Use a compatible low-voltage development board.

name: Low-Voltage Continuity Tester
description: Create a simple battery-powered tester that indicates continuity in disconnected wires.
safety: Test only disconnected, de-energized circuits. Never connect to wall outlets.

name: Reaction-Time Game
description: Build a game that measures how quickly a player responds to an LED signal.
safety: Use a low-voltage USB or battery supply.

name: RGB Color Mixer
description: Mix red, green, and blue LED channels to explore additive color.
safety: Use the correct current-limiting resistors for the LED.

name: Plant Moisture Indicator
description: Use a moisture sensor to indicate when soil is relatively dry or moist.
safety: Keep water away from exposed electronics and power connections.

name: Buzzer Melody Player
description: Generate simple tones with a small piezo buzzer and timed notes.
safety: Use a small low-voltage buzzer and keep volume comfortable.

name: Distance Alert
description: Measure nearby object distance with a sensor and signal when an object is close.
safety: Check the sensor's voltage requirements before wiring.

name: Mini Weather Station
description: Display temperature and humidity readings from a digital environmental sensor.
safety: Use a protected, low-voltage power source.

name: Capacitor Charge Demo
description: Observe how a capacitor affects the brightness or timing of a low-voltage LED circuit.
safety: Use only low-voltage components and observe capacitor polarity.

name: Servo Pointer
description: Control a small servo motor to point to different positions on a marked scale.
safety: Follow the servo's current requirements and avoid forcing its shaft.

name: Electronic Dice
description: Simulate a dice roll and show a random number using LEDs or a small display.
safety: Disconnect power before rewiring the project.

name: Sound-Level Indicator
description: Use a sound sensor module to light an LED when nearby sound passes a set threshold.
safety: Treat it as an educational indicator, not a calibrated sound meter.

name: Serial Sensor Monitor
description: Read a sensor and display its changing values in a serial monitor to practice debugging.
safety: Use a compatible board and USB power.
